plain_message: AI tool configuration file may contain plain-text API keys. Use environment variables or secret managers instead. Tools affected: Factory Droid, Cursor, VS Code, Warp, and other AI developer tools.
High-entropy token detected in AI tool configuration. This may be a secret or API key. Consider using environment variables or secret managers.

Proxy-based subscription routing detected (VibeProxy, CLIProxyAPI, etc.). This may violate provider Terms of Service. Verify compliance with Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, or other provider agreements.
Configuration pattern suggests accessing AI providers through non-standard endpoints. Verify this complies with provider ToS and your organization's AI usage policy.

AI agent tool configuration allows unrestricted access (wildcard permissions, no allowlists). This violates OWASP AI Agent Security principles. Implement scoped tool permissions with explicit allowlists.

AI agent memory configuration lacks validation or isolation. Unvalidated memory storage can lead to memory poisoning attacks (OWASP AI Agent Security). Implement memory validation and user/session isolation.
